newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-CHILE COACH ANGRY AT COLD SHOWERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHILE COACH ANGRY AT COLD SHOWERS.

text.p: Chile coach Nelson Acosta complained that his players were forced to take cold showers after his team's Copa America defeat against Paraguay on Wednesday as there was no hot water in the dressing room.
Acosta also said that when he tried to lodge an official complaint he could not find any official from the organising committee in the stadium.
Cochambama lies at 2,500 metres above sea level and temperatures can drop to near freezing at night during June.
The stadium in Cochabamba has just undergone renovations for the competition.
